_comment: Bundled defaults for the docs-hygiene file-name skills. Copy into .claude/docs-hygiene.json and edit. Every key is documented in plugins/docs-hygiene/reference/config.md. The values below are modelled on this marketplace's own: docs/ is the scope root, ADR, spec, and upstream trees are the historical tier, released changelog entries are frozen, and docs/architecture/landscape.json is generated rather than edited. A consuming repository adds its own historical paths and its own sweep exclusions; this marketplace's team layer carries several that are specific to it.

generated.regenerate: bash plugins/architecture/skills/map-landscape/scripts/landscape-record.sh --source 'current repository plus reference graph' --remote 'not used' --edges-from . . > docs/architecture/landscape.json
